description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceService class in the OrangeHRM application, providing a service layer for handling employee work experience data. It includes a reference to the data access object (DAO) and a method to retrieve it with lazy initialization.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceService
classes.description: Provides service layer functionalities for employee work experience, managing the associated DAO.
